comment: The two signal jacks and the output carry whatever is patched into them, so no family is given for them. The four trigger jacks are read as two OR-linked pairs through fabs(), so a negative pulse triggers as readily as a positive one; the README does not say this. The pair threshold is a rescale of 0.1V to 2V onto 0 to 1 before a default SchmittTrigger, so the pair fires when the summed magnitude passes 2V and rearms below 0.1V. Tr 2 is tested first and Tr 1 second, so a simultaneous pair ends with In 1 selected, which matches the README. The two lamps are lights with no ParamWidget and cannot be clicked.
